chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Hello, I'm Luis Serrano from Cohere AI.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: This video is about semantic search.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Semantic search is a really cool and powerful way to search in large databases using the

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: context of the query.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Let me show you how it works.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: This video accompanies this post that you can find in the Cohere blog about semantic

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: search.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: There's also a code lab that you can follow along where you create a semantic search model

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: for a small dataset.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Both links are in the description of the video.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So before we get into what is semantic search, let me show you what's not semantic search.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So basically, what were the previous methods used before semantic search?

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So for semantic search, the search methods resemble lexical search, which is basically

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: word matching.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: To show you how lexical search works, imagine that you have a query, say, where was the

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: last World Cup?

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And to find the response, you have a dataset of sentences.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Let's say it's just these four sentences, and the idea is to search in the dataset for

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: the answer, or at least the closest things to an answer.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So let's say that the possible answers are, the last World Cup was in Qatar, the sky is

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: blue, the bear lives in the woods, and an apple is a fruit.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So the way lexical search works is by word matching.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So it looks at which words from the query appear in the answer and counts them.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So the first sentence has five words in common with the query, the second one, one, the third

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: one, two, and the fourth one, zero.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So the first one wins.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And this time it did okay, actually found the answer.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: But as you can imagine, this creates some problems.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Imagine that the dataset of sentences are these ones.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: The previous World Cup was in Qatar, the cup is where you left it, where in the world is

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: my last cup of coffee, and an apple is a fruit.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So if you do lexical search, you compare the number of words in the sentences and in the

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: query, you get four, three, five, and zero.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So this one wins, where in the world is my last cup of coffee, even though it's not the

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: answer, it doesn't even have much to do with the query, but it has a lot of words in common.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So counting words in common is not the ideal way to search.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So we don't want lexical search.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Instead, we want something called semantic search, where instead of the words, the actual

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: meaning of the sentence is taken into account.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And for that, we need something very important, which is embeddings.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So in the comments, we have a blog post and a video which describe embeddings in a more

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: detailed way.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: But let me tell you very briefly what is a text embedding.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So here is a text embedding.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: For example, everything on the left is a word.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Here are the words, apple, banana, strawberry, all the way to car.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And the idea is that to each one of these, you assign two numbers.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And the numbers are the horizontal coordinate and the vertical coordinates.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So for example, banana has coordinates six, five.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And the idea is that similar words have similar points in the embedding.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So the fruits are close by the houses, the sports, and the vehicles are close by and

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: there are more to an embedding.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: But you can imagine it as something like this.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Of course, there's many more numbers for an embedding, not just two.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Sometimes you could have thousands, hundreds of thousands of or thousands of numbers.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: But that's the idea.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And so we can actually look at the embedding in the Cohere playground and put some sentences

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: because sentences also enter in embeddings, not just words.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And as you can see, all the sentences that look like they're greeting somebody are over

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: here.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: The sentences that look like they're talking about how much you love your dog are here.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And the sentences that talk about how much you enjoy watching soccer are over here.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So the idea of an embedding is that it brings a bunch of text into a bunch of numbers and

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: the numbers are similar if the text is similar, even if the text has no words in common with

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: other pieces of text.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Right.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Like if you have two sentences that mean something very similar, even though you have no words

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: in common, the embedding will put them close by.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Now the question is how to search using a text embedding.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Well, we're going to use something called nearest neighbors.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So let's say you have these four sentences again.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: The last World Cup was in Qatar.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: The sky is blue.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: The bear lives in the woods and an apple is a fruit.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And the query is where was the last World Cup?

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So let's locate everything on an embedding.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: The sentences get located, let's say, around here.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And when we locate the query, it gets located close to the first sentence.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: The last World Cup was in Qatar because semantically the embedding knows that these two sentences

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: are similar.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So therefore, the winner is the last World Cup was in Qatar.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And as you can see, this way of searching actually takes into account the meaning of

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: the sentence and not just the words on it.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So it's much more effective than lexical search.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: You can play with this in the Cohere playground.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: For example, you can take the actual sentences and locate them here in the embedding.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: That's where they are.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And when you have the query, where was the last World Cup?

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: It actually appears over here.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So as you can see, the answer is the closest sentence.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And you can actually put a bunch more questions.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And as you can see, each question is the closest to its answer.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So in principle, that's how nearest neighbors work.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: It looks for the nearest neighbor and says, well, I think I think this is the answer.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And it seems to work pretty well.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: However, I talked about distance, but in reality, we're talking about similarity.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Similar is a similar notion, except it's big when two things are close and small when two

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: things are far.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So, for example, the sentences, hello, how are you and hi, how's it going?

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Are close, so they would have high similarity.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And the sentences, hello, how are you?

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And yesterday's on elephant are far, so they would have low similarity.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: In the comments, there's also a video on a blog post that talk in much more detail about

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: different types of similarity that we can use for these models.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Now, there are some problems with nearest neighbors, which is it's good, but it's slow.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So imagine this.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Let's say that I want to find that the answer to where was the last World Cup is the last

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: World Cup was in Qatar.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So what I have to do, calculate a bunch of distances or a bunch of similarities.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: The fact is, I have to calculate as many as points in the data set.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And if I want to find the answer to all these questions, I pretty much have to calculate

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: a lot of distances.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So how many?

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Well, if we have eight sentences, then we have eight square distances.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Some of them are zero.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Eight of them are zero, but still around the order of eight square.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And if you had a thousand sentences, then we have one million distances because it's

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: a thousand square.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And if you have n sentences, you have n square distances.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: That's a lot to calculate.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So there's actually some shortcuts we can use to actually not have to calculate the

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: whole thing and find the nearest neighbor or at least something pretty close.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And some solutions to this are inverted file index, which actually first clusters the points

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: and then searches around the close ones.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Don't need to search on the ones that are very far in another cluster.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And the hierarchical navigable small world, something very similar.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Starts with a few points, search there, and then starts adding more points and more points.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: But using the information of what you had before, it's a much more effective way of

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: searching.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Now, this doesn't need to work in just one language.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: It actually works in many, many languages.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And the cohere multilingual model is very useful for that.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: If you look in the playground, you can actually play with the multilingual model.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: You can put a bunch of different sentences in different languages.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And so, for example, I have the same sentence in French, English and Spanish, and you can

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: see that the embedding actually locates them pretty close.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So you can have a data set of responses in one language and ask something in a different

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: language and you will find the best response.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So this is definitely language agnostic.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Now here's a question.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Are we done with just embedding and similarity?

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: It seemed to work pretty well, better than lexical search, but is it all?

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: You can imagine that there may be some potential problems, right?

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Here's a potential problem.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Let's say that our query is, where was the last World Cup, which is over here.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And the answers are, the last World Cup was in Qatar, the previous World Cup was in Russia,

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: and the World Cup is in the moon.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Now, these are all similar sentences because embedding only takes care of sentences that

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: are similar.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: It doesn't really check if the actual answer was given.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So for example, we would love for this one to be the answer, the last World Cup was in

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Qatar, but this sentence is also very close and it gives something pretty close to the

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: answer.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: The previous World Cup was in Russia.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: That's pretty close to the actual answer, but it's not the answer.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So looking for the closest sentence doesn't necessarily give us the answer.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: It gives us something pretty similar to the question.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So how can we fix that?

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: How can we make search better?

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And there are several techniques that we use.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: The first one is re-ranking.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So let's say that the query again is, where was the last World Cup?

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And when we look using an embedding, the most similar sentences are this.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Let's just say that these are the similar sentences and some of them are answers and

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: some of them are non-answers.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So we have a different model that ranks them.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So a model that is actually trained to see how good is a pair question answer and that

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: model will select the actual answer, the last World Cup was in Qatar.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So how does this work?

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Well, we have a data set of questions and answers and we train a model with those questions

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: and answers and we train it to give high scores to correct pairs of question answer

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: and to give low scores to pairs that are question and a bad answer.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And notice that you can try to make this really close.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: As you can see, the bad answers here are actually very close to being the right answer, except

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: they are slightly wrong.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: For example, the sky is red, the bear lives in New York City, or an apple is a vegetable.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: They look like the answer, but they're not.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And so a good model that's trained to tell good answers from bad answers will actually

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: be very good at re-ranking.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So then we're going to use an embedding plus re-ranking to be able to search better.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So if you say, for example, where was the last World Cup and the responses are these

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: given by the embedding, the closest sentences given by the embedding, then the model will

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: actually score all of them and say, well, some of them are not very good.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Some of them are pretty good.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And based on the scores, you rank them.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And the one with the highest score is the answer.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: This has given great, great results in terms of searching.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And another technique is to use something called positive and negative pairs.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So just like before, we're going to have a bunch of questions and answers that are correct

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: in the left as the positive pairs and a bunch of questions and bad answers, which are very

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: close to the answer, but not the answer.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And we are going to play with the embedding.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So for example, if here you have what color is the sky and the actual answer, the sky

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: is blue and a bad answer, the sky is above.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Well, if this is a negative pair, then we're going to move them away in the embedding.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And if this is a positive pair, then we're going to move them closely in the embedding.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: So we're going to move the embedding around to actually optimize for answering questions

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: properly.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: This has also proven very useful in improving search models vastly.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: And that's it for semantic search.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: As you can imagine, there are many, many great ways to improve these algorithms and we're

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: always working on them.

chunks.title: What is Semantic Search
chunks.text: Stay tuned for more similar videos.
